svg.title: A search node assigns some ports S present and some F absent. Propagation closes prerequisites and their contrapositives, propagates incompatibilities, enforces the cardinality cap, and forces the unique available element of a still-uncovered cut. An inconsistent node is infeasible. Write DS for the cuts not yet hit and U = [m] \ (S ∪F). For nonnegative numbers yD with ∑︂
